name: create-refused-v0.1-workers

graded_by.test: core/internal/worker/version_test.go — with only v0.1 supervisors live, POST /sessions answers 503 worker_unavailable, its message saying the workers predate the core, and no connection on a v0.1 worker is reused
harness/rigs/n1-negative.sh — creation is refused 503 while only v0.1 workers run

description: No new session on a v0.1 worker (orchestrator DEFAULT, approval page). The core creates workers only through a supervisor whose manifest carries a C3 version it speaks, and never reuses a connection on a v0.1 worker: a session there would get no heartbeat, so a hung worker would never be found, and no worker-run timers, so an orphan would have no bound if the core were lost (session model §14 rejects that). With only v0.1 supervisors, POST /sessions answers 503 worker_unavailable with a message saying the workers predate the core. The cost: after a core-only upgrade, no new session until the workers restart — which the E1 upgrade does once (manage.sh restart-workers).

error.message: the workers predate this core (contract-v0.1): no session is created on them; restart the workers
